proof_body:
by
  intro n p _ _
  have h0 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n.choose k : ℝ) * p ^ k * (1 - p) ^ (n - k)) = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (Polynomial.eval p) (bernsteinPolynomial.sum ℝ n)
    simpa [bernsteinPolynomial, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum] using h
  have h1 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (k : ℝ) * ((n.choose k : ℝ) * p ^ k * (1 - p) ^ (n - k)) = n * p := by
    have h := congrArg (Polynomial.eval p) (bernsteinPolynomial.sum_smul ℝ n)
    simpa [bernsteinPolynomial, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, nsmul_eq_mul] using h
  have h2 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1)) * ((n.choose k : ℝ) * p ^ k * (1 - p) ^ (n - k)) = n * (n - 1) * p ^ 2 := by
    have h := congrArg (Polynomial.eval p) (bernsteinPolynomial.sum_mul_smul ℝ n)
    have hc : ∀ k : ℕ, (k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) = (k : ℝ) * ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      intro k
      cases k <;> simp
    simp_rw [hc]
    simpa [bernsteinPolynomial, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul] using h
  have hsplit : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((k : ℝ) - n * p) ^ 2 * ((n.choose k : ℝ) * p ^ k * (1 - p) ^ (n - k))
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1)) * ((n.choose k : ℝ) * p ^ k * (1 - p) ^ (n - k))
        + (1 - 2 * (n * p)) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (k : ℝ) * ((n.choose k : ℝ) * p ^ k * (1 - p) ^ (n - k))
        + (n * p) ^ 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((n.choose k : ℝ) * p ^ k * (1 - p) ^ (n - k)) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    ring
  rw [hsplit, h0, h1, h2]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : ℝ), 0 ≤ p → p ≤ 1 → ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((k : ℝ) - n * p) ^ 2 * ((n.choose k : ℝ) * p ^ k * (1 - p) ^ (n - k)) = n * p * (1 - p)
